notes.title: Ease of Play Update
notes.content:
v0.1.08
--------
[list]
   [*]Added warning system to let players know if their deck is invalid. The decks become invalid when they have too many of a card that has had its deck limits lowered. If you try to play with an invalid deck, it will be swapped with the “Default Deck.”
   [*]Added a blue or red line that shows which monster a equip card is attached to in order to make it easier to know who is buffed or weakened. This shows up when highlighting either the monster or the equip card with your main hand. 
   [*]Revealing equip spells now activate the spell immediately, getting rid of the extra step of having to hit the sphere. You can still cancel the spell (grip button) and activate it later if you’d like. 
   [*]Fixed bug that allowed players to activate spells twice.
   [*] Fixed visual bug that caused an extra monster to spawn on the arena when using "Reborn"
[/list]

tags.feature: [*]Added warning system to let players know if their deck is invalid. The decks become invalid when they have too many of a card that has had its deck limits lowered. If you try to play with an invalid deck, it will be swapped with the “Default Deck.”

[*]Added a blue or red line that shows which monster a equip card is attached to in order to make it easier to know who is buffed or weakened. This shows up when highlighting either the monster or the equip card with your main hand.

[*]Revealing equip spells now activate the spell immediately, getting rid of the extra step of having to hit the sphere. You can still cancel the spell (grip button) and activate it later if you’d like.

tags.bug: [*]Fixed bug that allowed players to activate spells twice.
[*] Fixed visual bug that caused an extra monster to spawn on the arena when using "Reborn"

notes.title: Special Ability Update
notes.content:
v0.1.07
--------

[b]New Special Ability Monsters:[/b]
[b]These monsters have been upgraded to have unique attributes:[/b]
[list]
   [*][b]Insectobot[/b]: [Special Ability] [i]When this card is destroyed in combat, deal 500 damage to enemy health and summon 1 Insectobot from deck or hand[/i]
   [*][b]Demon Maggot[/b]: [Special Ability] [i]When this monster is flipped from face down, destroy a face up enemy monster with the most attack[/i]
[/list]

Changes:
[list]
   [*]Monsters can no longer be revealed the same turn they are played face down
   [*]Attack Up, Attack Down, Defense Up, and Power Swap can no longer be played on face down monsters
   [*]Attack Up, Attack Down, and Defense up will now stay on the field until the monster they are used on is destroyed. 
   [*]Monster stats now return to normal when they are destroyed and sent to the graveyard
   [*]Demon Maggots deck limit is reduced 3->1
[/list]

Bugs:
[list]
   [*]Fixed the rare chance for AI stopping mid match
   [*]Decks not saving correctly. If this happens, delete the deck and remake it. Once deleted it should save any new changes properly.
[/list]

[b]Demon Maggot[/b]: [Special Ability] [i]When this monster is flipped from face down, destroy a face up enemy monster with the most attack[/i]

notes.title: Spectating Update
notes.content:

--------

[b]Spectating:[/b] 
[list]
   [*]Rooms now have a player limit of 4. When players 3 and 4 join a room they will be placed on the sides of the battle room as Spectators

 [*]Spells VFX are again visible to all other players who did not actually use the spell.

[list]
   [*]Red players decks will now go down as they draw cards and accurately depict how many cards are left in the deck.  
[/list]
[b]New Bugs:[/b]
[list]   
[*]If you use the Relocation button in the Main Menu room you might be teleported back when you click on an open room. This does not stop you from entering the room.
[/list]

notes.title: Rematch and Mute
notes.content:
v0.1.01
--------

This weeks update includes the two most requested features since releasing to Early Access:
[list]
  [*] Rematch Sphere is now in the battle room next to the Exit Sphere. After both players press it, the battle will restart without the players having to leave the room.
  [*] Mute sphere is now in the battle room to the left of the console. There is also -/+ spheres that decrease/increase the voice volume of the opposing player.
  [*] Fixed a bug where the graveyard spheres would randomly highlight even when the player is not putting their hand on the spheres. 
[/list]

- Mute sphere is now in the battle room to the left of the console. There is also -/+ spheres that decrease/increase the voice volume of the opposing player.

notes.title: Lighting Update
notes.content:
[b]v.0.0.9[/b]
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This update includes various bug fixes for multiplayer as well as new art, audio, and monster card.

[b]Art:[/b]
- Added lighting for main menu room and battle room.
- New assets and textures in main menu and battle rooms.
- Turn Lights added on top of player consoles. These help players know whose turn it is. 
- Added new VFX to monsters, spells, and environment

[b]Audio[/b]: 
- Monsters now play their audio when they attack. 
- New music for both rooms.
- New sounds for playing a card, destroying a monster, or when an attack fails.
- More recognizable sound when a phase changes. 

[b]Cards[/b]: 
-New Monster: Scorpion Man. A genetically mutated man who been turned into a scorpion hybrid who requires a special mask to survive.

[b]Known Bugs[/b]:
- Exit sphere in battle room doesn’t work.
- VFX not showing up for opponents in multiplayer.
- If a sacrifice monster is played directly on top of another monster there can be errors in multiplayer. To avoid this play the sacrifice card in an empty monster slot.

notes.title: VFX update
notes.content:
V.0.0.7
--------------------------------------------

Were back with our first update for the new year! This one incorporates functioning visual FX which we have wanted to get in for a long time. We have plans for many more and the ones we have now really help bring life to the battles, along with giving visual feedback to the player about what is happening in game.

The cards that now have VFX are:
-"Attack/Defense up": A green burst shows up around the effected monster
-"Attack down" : A red burst shows up around the effected monster
-"Reborn": Yellow rings display that the monster was brought back from the graveyard
-"Flamethrower Beetle": Fire shoots out of the beetle when it attacks
-"Lightning Beetle": Lightning shoots out of the beetle when it attacks
-"Blue Moon": A bright blue light raises to the sky 
-"Lightning Strike": A storm cloud appears above the enemy player and they are struck by lightning

To prevent confusion the "Attack down" card has new artwork that reduces the possibility of players using it on the wrong monster. 

A new  monster has been added to the decks: "Vengeful Bodyguard" a powerful 4-skull monster with an intimidating presense and robotic heart!

tags.feature: This one incorporates functioning visual FX which we have wanted to get in for a long time.
- "Attack/Defense up": A green burst shows up around the effected monster
- "Attack down" : A red burst shows up around the effected monster
- "Reborn": Yellow rings display that the monster was brought back from the graveyard
- "Flamethrower Beetle": Fire shoots out of the beetle when it attacks
- "Lightning Beetle": Lightning shoots out of the beetle when it attacks
- "Blue Moon": A bright blue light raises to the sky
- "Lightning Strike": A storm cloud appears above the enemy player and they are struck by lightning

notes.title: Auto Phase update
notes.content:
Build v0.0.6
------------------------------------------------
- The player will now automatically go into Main Phase at the start of their turn. 

Before the players had an option of going into Main or Battle phase first, but at the cost of slowing down gameplay and often confusing new players. Making the turn start in Main Phase was a highly requested feature that should allow for quicker, more fluid gameplay.

- Replaced player avatar to fit the art and lore more

- Updated console to make enemy cards and health easier to reach and target. 

- Reposition button should now work for everyone in multiplayer matches.

tags.feature: - The player will now automatically go into Main Phase at the start of their turn.
- Replaced player avatar to fit the art and lore more
- Updated console to make enemy cards and health easier to reach and target.

tags.bug: - Reposition button should now work for everyone in multiplayer matches.
